declared_service_paths.name: Sensor-yoke stack forward lead-window release
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Unload/restrain and remove springs, guide rods, rear caps and H18/H19 retention; preload0. Keep the integrated frame/palm in place. Retain H13/H15 while removing the complete sensor/yoke stack.

declared_service_paths.name: Sensor-yoke stack final upward removal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Unload/restrain and remove springs, guide rods, rear caps and H18/H19 retention; preload0. Keep the integrated frame/palm in place. Retain H13/H15 while removing the complete sensor/yoke stack.

declared_service_paths.name: Adjuster12mm forward thread release
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Remove sensor/yoke stack first; release H21 locking screw, keep the brass pad retained. Unscrew H13 toward+X, then lift only after the complete thread clears H11.

declared_service_paths.name: Adjuster40mm upward removal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Remove sensor/yoke stack first; release H21 locking screw, keep the brass pad retained. Unscrew H13 toward+X, then lift only after the complete thread clears H11.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper screw12mm forward withdrawal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Sensor/yoke stack and H13 removed; support H15. Counterhold H17 from above with a slim AF5.5 open-end wrench. Fully remove both H16 screws toward+X; actual wiring disconnected/secured. The initial0..0.05mm seated cone release is certified separately by its analytic axial envelope.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper nut40mm upward withdrawal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Both H16 screws completely removed; lift the loose square nuts out with the wrench or tweezers.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper screw12mm forward withdrawal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Sensor/yoke stack and H13 removed; support H15. Counterhold H17 from above with a slim AF5.5 open-end wrench. Fully remove both H16 screws toward+X; actual wiring disconnected/secured. The initial0..0.05mm seated cone release is certified separately by its analytic axial envelope.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper nut40mm upward withdrawal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Both H16 screws completely removed; lift the loose square nuts out with the wrench or tweezers.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper2mm wristward release
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Remove sensor/yoke stack,H13,both H16 screws and both H17 nuts; keep frame/palm fixed.

declared_service_paths.name: Keeper35mm upward removal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Keeper already shifted2mm wristward through the lower palm service notch; H16/H17/H13 absent.

declared_service_paths.name: M6 nut9mm forward release

declared_service_paths.name: M6 nut40mm upward removal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: M6 nut already advanced9mm into the empty sensor cavity.

declared_service_paths.name: Case20mm direct downward removal
declared_service_paths.prerequisites: Support device clear of bench; remove both underside enclosure M2 screws and disconnect/secure wiring. Closed P08/P09/P10/electronics module lowers as a unit; integrated frame/palm stays fixed.
